messages:
Leah (CS): Quick thread to capture BrightMap feedback from today's demo. Main asks + a reproducible embedding issue. Renewal check-in on 2026-04-20; finance needs cost detail to move forward.

Sam (CS): Can you bullet the asks? I'll add notes to the account.

Leah (CS): Short bullets:
- Ask A (URGENT): exportable per-route cost summary (CSV with route, model, tokens, cost)
- Ask B (VALUE): team-scoped prompt presets (so non-admins can reuse curated prompts)
- Ask C (OPTIONAL): ability to pin model version for a route (useful during canary tests)
Bug: embeddings for Route X and Route Y return near-duplicate vectors even though inputs differ. Screenshot/log attached: https://files.redwood/brightmap/embed-err.png

Ivy (Solutions): For the CSV, do they want raw provider pricing or only our calculated per-token cost? Also any PHI concerns?

Leah (CS): They asked for calculated cost only (no provider rates). No PHI in payloads, but they want a single spreadsheet for their FP&A review.

Ravi (PM): I'll create product tasks and tag renewal-risk. Priorities: P0 for cost export, P1 for presets, P2 for pin control. Need eng estimates and security sign-off for CSV export.

OpsBot: Ticket RF-3301 created for "BrightMap per-route cost export" by Ravi. https://tracker.redwood/RF-3301

Marco (Product): Sam/Leah — can you collect a minimal repro for the embeddings mismatch? Might be preprocessing divergence between routes.

Sam (CS): Yep. I'll capture samples and preprocessing diffs and upload a small notebook by EOD.

Leah (CS): BrightMap requested a short-term workaround: support-exported daily aggregates until product change ships. That would buy ~3-5 weeks.

Ivy (Solutions): I'll mock a CSV schema that hides rate math but shows tokens and computed cost columns. Will include security checklist and sample export.

Ravi (PM): Adding follow-up task RF-3302 for "model pin toggle" (low complexity). Assigning Marco for scoping.

OpsBot: Ticket RF-3302 created for "Model pin toggle (BrightMap)" by Ravi. https://tracker.redwood/RF-3302

Marco (Product): Aiming to return a T-shirt estimate for RF-3301 by Thursday. Sam, ping eng-ml if notebook points to model-serving issue.

Sam (CS): Will do. Including trace id 0x9c4b in the notebook for SRE.

Leah (CS): I'm scheduling BrightMap follow-up for next Tue 10am PT. Need rough estimate by then to keep renewal healthy.

Marco (Product): Noted. I'll update RF-3301 as soon as we have an estimate. Thanks everyone.

Ivy (Solutions): Mock and CSV sample posted in thread — see link: https://files.redwood/brightmap/csv-mock-01.csv

Leah (CS): Closing for now. Will paste customer acceptance criteria after the call. If anyone adds more context, thread it here. :raised_hands:
